zh.title: 蒙特婁機場（YUL）員工遭French Bee客機撞擊身亡
zh.summary: 蒙特婁機場一名Samsic員工遭後退的客機撞擊不幸身亡
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導，蒙特婁機場（YUL；Montreal Airport）發生一起嚴重的地面安全事故。一名任職於 Samsic 的機場員工，在遭遇到一架正在進行後退作業的 French Bee 航空公司客機碰撞後不幸宣告身亡。
在今日稍早的相關報導中，航空媒體 AeroTime 曾指出該名蒙特婁機場員工在被飛機撞擊後受到重傷。然而隨後的消息證實，該名 Samsic 員工已不幸因傷勢過重而去世。目前這起事故的具體發生原因與後續安全調查細節仍有待相關部門進一步釐清。

en.title: Montreal Airport (YUL) Employee Struck and Killed by Backing French Bee Aircraft
en.summary: French Bee aircraft strikes and kills Samsic employee while backing up at Montreal Airport
body: An airport worker has tragically died after being struck by a commercial aircraft at Montreal Airport (YUL). According to reports from Simple Flying, the victim was an employee of Samsic who was hit by a French Bee aircraft while the airplane was backing up on the ground.

Earlier on Tuesday, aviation news website AeroTime initially reported that the Montreal airport worker had been seriously injured after being struck by an aircraft. It was later confirmed that the Samsic employee tragically passed away from their injuries. The specific circumstances surrounding the ground accident remain to be clarified.

zh.title: 孟加拉草擬向中國及土耳其採購軍機文件
zh.summary: 孟加拉政府委員會草擬談判文件；軍方推動多項現代化計畫
body: 孟加拉政府委員會已為兩項規劃中的採購案草擬談判文件，內容涉及中國殲-10CE多用途戰機與攻擊直升機，相關訊息由資訊與廣播顧問Zahed Ur Rahman於2026年8月25日發布。
該顧問表示，孟加拉空軍正推動多項現代化計畫，包括第四代多用途戰機、其他戰機、攻擊與VIP直升機，以及無人飛行系統。
依據孟加拉方面的簡報，若經費許可，採購案將於2026至27財政年度進行；否則將延至下一年度預算。截至目前，達卡與北京均未證實需求數量究竟是20或24架。
攻擊直升機項目據《Times of Bangladesh》報導，疑似涉及土耳其航太的T129 ATAK，但孟加拉空軍與土耳其航太尚未公開宣布T129訂單。

en.title: Bangladesh drafts agreement documents for Chinese fighters, Turkish attack helicopters
en.summary: Bangladesh government committee drafts negotiation documents for J-10CE fighters and attack helicopters; air force pursues modernization
body: A Bangladeshi government committee has prepared draft documents for negotiations over two planned acquisitions: Chinese J-10CE multirole fighters and attack helicopters, Zahed Ur Rahman, information and broadcasting adviser to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, said on August 25, 2026.

The adviser said the Bangladesh Air Force was pursuing several modernization projects, including fourth-generation multirole combat aircraft, other fighters, attack and VIP helicopters, and unmanned aerial systems.
The procurements would be pursued during fiscal 2026-27 if funding were available, or taken up in the following budget otherwise, according to the Bangladesh briefing.

The attack-helicopter element appears to concern Turkish Aerospace's T129 ATAK, according to a report by the Times of Bangladesh, though neither the Bangladesh Air Force nor Turkish Aerospace has publicly announced a T129 order.
